Description: Event times, types, HED tags, and merged mind-wandering probe metadata for task-meditation (wide tables include merge columns; see TaskMetadata).

TaskMetadata.Description: Task-level metadata and HED annotations for task-meditation event tables in the ds001787 dataset. Primary merged artifact is `sub-*_ses-*_task-meditation_events_merged.tsv` (wide table produced by tools/pdf-extraction/merge_sub01_events.py and batch_merge_all.py). These tables align EEG event markers with PsychToolbox text logs (*_info.txt; run_mw_experiment6.m). Compared with the curated ds001787 release, this merged table retains unpaired EEG-orphan rows and txt-only rows; rows are flagged via merge_note, source, and complete_trial.

onset.Description: Event onset time relative to the first EEG sample of the continuous recording. For matched stimulus and response rows this is the EEG marker time; for txt-only rows (no matching EEG stimulus within tolerance) it is the PsychToolbox tic/toc time shifted into EEG-clock seconds via offset_guess.

duration.Description: Event duration. All events in this dataset are discrete markers, so this column is always n/a.

trial_type.Description: Semantic event category. stimulus rows begin a mind-wandering (MW) probe trial (EEG trigger 128); response rows are key presses (trigger values 1, 2, 4, or 8) within the same probe sequence; question rows come from txt-only blocks where no EEG stimulus could be paired; STATUS rows are BioSemi acquisition markers (value 254) and are excluded from analysis. Use txt_label to distinguish ordered response identity.

Levels.stimulus: Mind-wandering probe trial onset in EEG (marker 128 on parallel-port line 8); paired with MW_question times in the text log after clock alignment.
Levels.response: Key response to one ordered question within the MW probe sequence; order within the trial maps to text-log key lines by txt_label and merge_note.
Levels.question: Txt-only probe onset emitted when the merger could not pair a text-log MW block to any EEG stimulus 128 within tolerance; onset is mw_time + offset_guess.
Levels.STATUS: BioSemi acquisition system marker (value 254 in this dataset). Not generated by the PsychToolbox paradigm script.

response_time.Description: Reserved BIDS column; always n/a in this dataset. Rating responses are conveyed by the EEG trigger code in value (and the per-key text-log line) rather than as a continuous response latency relative to the stimulus.

sample.Description: Zero-based sample index of the event relative to the first stored sample of the continuous recording, per the BIDS events spec. Within rounding it satisfies sample = round(onset * SamplingFrequency); e.g. onset 71.3867187500 s at 256 Hz = sample 18275. n/a for txt-only rows.

value.Description: Integer event code on the BioSemi parallel-port marker channel (EEGLAB-style import). Per run_mw_experiment6.m (Delorme, 2014), key n in {0,1,2,3} is sent on parallel-port line n+1, producing trigger value 2^n: keys 0/1/2/3 -> trigger values 1/2/4/8. The MW probe is sent on parallel-port line 8, producing 128. Values 16 and 254 are not generated by the paradigm script; they originate from the BioSemi system marker stream. In merged wide event tables, any response row with numeric key_code_txt sets value to 2**key_code_txt so value matches the text-log key; onset and sample still reflect the EEG marker row when that row exists.

Levels.0: Marker channel zero in the exported EEG events row, or missing sample where no trigger was decoded. Merged response rows with key_code_txt use 2**key_code_txt (never 0 for keys 0-3).
Levels.1: EEG marker for key line 1 (key 0; rating value 0). Permitted by the paradigm code but not observed in any exported event table in this dataset.
Levels.2: EEG marker for key line 2 (key 1; rating value 1) within an MW probe response block.
Levels.3: Nonstandard value 3 on the marker channel in some merged exports (does not match 2^n key coding); treat as data-quality flag and cross-check key_code_txt.
Levels.4: EEG marker for key line 3 (key 2; rating value 2) within an MW probe response block.
Levels.8: EEG marker for key line 4 (key 3; rating value 3) within an MW probe response block.
Levels.16: Mid-recording marker observed in some BioSemi exports; not generated by run_mw_experiment6.m. Semantics unknown (likely parallel-port artifact or hardware code).
Levels.128: MW probe stimulus trigger on parallel-port line 8 (primary trial anchor for aligning EEG blocks with MW_question lines in *_info.txt).
Levels.254: BioSemi acquisition status marker (typically a recording-start sentinel, high byte 0xFE on the trigger channel).

trial_index.Description: 1-based index of the MW experience-sampling probe trial within the run after pairing EEG stimulus blocks with behavioral-log trials. Rows sharing the same index belong to one ordered probe sequence (one stimulus plus up to three rating responses). n/a for unpaired EEG-orphan rows.

txt_label.Description: Ordered trial role relative to the PsychToolbox text log (same session *_info.txt). MW_question marks the probe onset; key_status_1, key_status_2, and key_status_3 identify the first, second, and third ordered rating responses within the probe sequence. The ordered response types are meditation depth, mind-wandering depth, and tiredness, respectively.

Levels.MW_question: Probe onset line in the text log reporting when the experience-sampling MW question sequence began (paired with EEG stimulus code 128 after EEG-minus-log offset estimation).
Levels.key_status_0: Text-log status counter 0 on a key line (between-probe reset / not one of the three ordered rating prompts); rare in merged tables.
Levels.key_status_1: First ordered response in the probe sequence: rating of meditation depth for the immediately preceding interval (0 = not meditating at all; 3 = deep meditative state).
Levels.key_status_2: Second ordered response in the probe sequence: rating of mind-wandering depth for the immediately preceding interval (0 = not mind wandering at all; 3 = immersed in thoughts).
Levels.key_status_3: Third ordered response in the probe sequence: rating of tiredness/drowsiness for the immediately preceding interval (0 = not drowsy at all; 3 = very drowsy).
Levels.response_1: Legacy label equivalent to key_status_1 (meditation-depth rating).
Levels.response_2: Legacy label equivalent to key_status_2 (mind-wandering-depth rating).
Levels.response_3: Legacy label equivalent to key_status_3 (tiredness/drowsiness rating).
Levels.unpaired_stimulus: EEG-only stimulus row (orphan): a 128 trigger with no matching MW_question line in the text log within tolerance.
Levels.orphan_response: EEG-only response row in an unpaired stimulus block (follows unpaired_stimulus).

txt_onset_log_s.Description: Time in seconds from the PsychToolbox tic/toc clock for MW_question or key events as written to *_info.txt by run_mw_experiment6.m. To recover the EEG-clock equivalent without manual arithmetic, use txt_onset_eeg_clock_s. n/a when no text-log line exists for the row (e.g. unpaired EEG stimuli or extra EEG responses).

txt_onset_eeg_clock_s.Description: PsychToolbox text-log time projected onto the EEG sample clock by adding the per-trial offset (trial_clock_offset_s for matched blocks, offset_guess for txt-only blocks). For matched stimulus rows this equals onset within float precision; for matched response rows it indicates when the participant pressed each rating key on the EEG clock, even though onset reflects the EEG marker time. n/a for unpaired EEG-orphan rows and EEG responses with no matching text-log key line. Authority: trust txt-derived behavioral timing, while keeping onset as the canonical EEG-clock recorded time.

complete_trial.Description: Row-level QC flag emitted by tools/pdf-extraction/merge_sub01_events.py:complete_trial. Mirrors the validity rules in tools/pdf-extraction/eda.py.

Levels.1: Row is part of a run of three or more consecutive response rows (a complete probe triplet), or the immediately preceding non-response row that initiates the probe (typically stimulus or question).
Levels.0: Neutral / incomplete: row does not belong to a complete triplet and is not adjacent to any other stimulus-class row.
Levels.-1: STATUS row, or a stimulus-class row directly adjacent to another stimulus-class row (consecutive probes without intervening responses; data-quality flag for downstream review).

merge_note.Description: Provenance of row alignment between EEG markers and the text log, written by the merger script in tools/pdf-extraction. Pairing is forward-only with a per-trial tolerance of 8 s after offset selection. Unlike the curated ds001787 release, merged event tables in this dataset retain unpaired EEG-orphan rows (no_matching_MW_line_in_txt_for_this_128_trigger / follows_unpaired_stimulus) so that QC and downstream tools can decide whether to keep them. Deliverable: `sub-*_ses-*_task-meditation_events_merged.tsv` beside the raw `_events.tsv`.

Levels.aligned_by_order: Response row matched to the corresponding text-log key line by sequence within the trial after stimulus pairing. value is set to 2**key_code_txt (same rule as text-only inferred rows).
Levels.stimulus_value_128_is_MW_prompt_in_EEG: Stimulus row: EEG value 128 identifies the MW probe on parallel-port line 8 from run_mw_experiment6.m. Canonical stimulus label emitted by the merger.
Levels.txt_key0_present_in_eeg_rare: Text log reports key code 0 for this response index while the EEG stream still carries a response marker (flagged for manual QC). value is coerced to 2**0 (=1) per key_code_txt and may disagree with the raw EEG marker value on that row.
Levels.eeg_response_without_txt_key_at_this_ind: EEG response present at this ordered slot but no matching key line in the text block.
Levels.txt_key0_without_matching_eeg_response_r: Text log reports key code 0 for this ordered response while no EEG response row was aligned at the same index (timing from text clock). value is 2**0 (=1).
Levels.txt_key_without_matching_eeg_response_ro: Text log reports a non-zero key for this ordered response while no EEG response row was aligned at the same index (timing from text clock). value is 2**key_code_txt.
Levels.no_matching_EEG_stimulus_for_this_MW_blo: Text-log MW probe block with no EEG stimulus 128 within tolerance; merger emits text-derived rows whose onset is mw_time + offset_guess (no EEG sample).
Levels.txt_key_without_eeg_trial_match: Text-log key row from a text-only block (companion rows to no_matching_EEG_stimulus_for_this_MW_block). value is 2**key_code_txt.
Levels.no_matching_MW_line_in_txt_for_this_128_: EEG stimulus 128 without a paired MW_question line. Retained in this dataset; flagged via complete_trial when it is consecutive with other stimulus-class rows.
Levels.follows_unpaired_stimulus: Response rows following an EEG-only stimulus block with no text MW line. Retained in this dataset for QC.

source.Description: Origin of the row in `*_task-meditation_events_merged.tsv`. eeg+txt rows are matched probes; txt_only rows come from text-log MW blocks with no EEG stimulus pair; eeg_orphan rows come from EEG stimulus blocks with no text MW pair (retained in this dataset).

Levels.eeg+txt: Matched pair: EEG stimulus paired with a text-log MW block within the 8 s tolerance after offset selection.
Levels.txt_only: Text-log probe with no matching EEG stimulus; onset is mw_time + offset_guess.
Levels.eeg_orphan: EEG stimulus 128 (and its trailing response rows) without a matching text-log MW block.

key_code_txt.Description: PsychToolbox key code (0-3) parsed from *_info.txt for this response row. The merged table sets value to 2**key_code_txt for rating rows with a key line. n/a when no text-log key line is associated with the row.

status_txt.Description: Probe status counter from the text log indicating which ordered question this response answers (1=meditation depth, 2=mind-wandering depth, 3=tiredness). n/a when no text-log key line is associated with the row.

trial_clock_offset_s.Description: Per-trial EEG-minus-text-log clock offset used to project the text-log clock onto the EEG clock. Equal to EEG_stimulus_onset - mw_time for matched probes, and to offset_guess for txt-only probes.

hed_def_sensory.Description: Definitions for sensory presentations in the experience-sampling probe paradigm.

HED.mw_probe_audio_def: (Definition/MW-probe-audio, (Auditory-presentation, Vocalized-sound, Description/Pre-recorded vocalized question presented via freestanding speakers prompting the participant to rate their internal state on a 0 to 3 scale during seated concentration meditation.))
HED.resume_meditation_audio_def: (Definition/Resume-meditation-audio, (Auditory-presentation, Vocalized-sound, Description/Audio instruction played after the tiredness rating telling the participant to resume their meditation.))

hed_def_actions.Description: Definitions for participant actions during the experience-sampling probe sequence.

HED.press_rating_key_def: (Definition/Press-rating-key, ((Hand, (Right-side-of, Experiment-participant)), (Press, Keyboard-key), Description/Participant presses a key 0 through 3 on a USB numeric keypad resting on their right thigh to provide a subjective rating with eyes closed.))

hed_def_conds.Description: Definitions for the three ordered self-report rating scales that form the experience-sampling probe sequence. All three ratings refer to the same time interval immediately preceding the probe.

HED.meditation_depth_cond_def: (Definition/Meditation-depth-cond, (Condition-variable/Rating-type, Label/Meditation-depth, Description/First ordered rating in the probe sequence. Participant rates the subjective depth of meditative absorption for the period immediately preceding the probe on a scale from 0 not meditating at all to 3 deep meditative state.))
HED.mind_wandering_depth_cond_def: (Definition/Mind-wandering-depth-cond, (Condition-variable/Rating-type, Label/Mind-wandering-depth, Description/Second ordered rating in the probe sequence. Participant rates the subjective depth of mind wandering for the period immediately preceding the probe on a scale from 0 not mind wandering at all to 3 immersed in thoughts.))
HED.tiredness_cond_def: (Definition/Tiredness-cond, (Condition-variable/Rating-type, Label/Tiredness, Description/Third ordered rating in the probe sequence. Participant rates the subjective level of tiredness or drowsiness at the time of the probe on a scale from 0 not drowsy at all to 3 very drowsy.))

HED.concentration_meditation_task_def: (Definition/Concentration-meditation-task, (Task, Experiment-participant, Label/Mantra-meditation, Description/Seated concentration meditation in the Himalayan Yoga tradition using mantra repetition with eyes closed. Participants maintain meditative focus between pseudorandomly spaced experience-sampling probes presented every 30 to 90 seconds.))
HED.experience_sampling_probe_task_def: (Definition/Experience-sampling-probe-task, (Task, Experiment-participant, (Hear, Vocalized-sound), (Judge, Label/Internal-state), (Press, Keyboard-key), Description/Attend to three sequential audio probes and rate meditation depth then mind-wandering depth then tiredness by pressing keys 0 through 3 on a numeric keypad.))

hed_def_setup.Description: Definitions for recording setup and hardware markers not generated by the paradigm script.

HED.biosemi_status_marker_def: (Definition/Biosemi-status-marker, (Experiment-control, Recording, Description/BioSemi acquisition system status marker value 254 typically indicating recording start or a system sentinel on the trigger channel.))
HED.unknown_biosemi_marker_def: (Definition/Unknown-biosemi-marker, (Experiment-control, Description/Unclassified mid-recording marker from the BioSemi system not generated by the paradigm script. Rows should be excluded from analysis pending QC.))

ExperimentalParadigm.Description: Probe-caught experience-sampling paradigm during seated concentration meditation, based on Brandmeyer and Delorme, Reduced mind wandering in experienced meditators and associated EEG correlates (DOI: 10.1007/s00221-016-4811-5; PMID: 27815577) and implemented in code/run_mw_experiment6.m (Arnaud Delorme, Jan 20 2014). The article describes a 45-90 minute experiment, at least 30 probes, and a 5-minute training block before the experiment; those values describe the published protocol and are not enforced by this script. The script as committed here uses expeDuration=1800 s (30 min single run), minDuration=150 s plus a uniform 0-15 s jitter between probes, probe mode (mode='p'), and BioSemi parallel-port triggers via the legacy MATLAB digitalio API. Audio prompts are PsychToolbox sound() playback of WAV files: voice_rate_med plays at probe onset (status 0->1), voice_rate_mw plays after the meditation-depth key (status 1->2), voice_rate_tired plays after the mind-wandering-depth key (status 2->3), and voice_resumemed plays after the tiredness key (status 3->0).

OrderedTrialTypes.Prompt: Begin ordered self-report sequence for the same immediately preceding meditation interval.
Please rate the depth of your meditation.
OrderedTrialTypes.Scale: 0 = not meditating at all; 3 = deep meditative state.

OrderedTrialTypes.Prompt: Please rate the depth of your mind wandering.
OrderedTrialTypes.Scale: 0 = not mind wandering at all; 3 = immersed in thoughts.

OrderedTrialTypes.Prompt: Please rate how tired you are.
OrderedTrialTypes.Scale: 0 = not drowsy at all; 3 = very drowsy.

ExperimentalParadigm.ResponseScale: Behavioral key values 0-3 are written to the text log; EEG response triggers in the curated events table are parallel-port marker values 1/2/4/8 (= 2^key) and should be interpreted with txt_label for ordered question identity. All three ratings refer to the same time interval immediately preceding the probe.
ExperimentalParadigm.ReturnToTask: After the ordered ratings, the paradigm plays voice_resumemed ("You may now resume your meditation") and resets status to 0.

StimulusPresentation.SoftwareVersion: n/a (not recorded; see run_mw_experiment6.m, Arnaud Delorme, Jan 20 2014)
StimulusPresentation.Description: MW probes and key responses logged to *_info.txt via PsychToolbox tic/toc/KbCheck/sound; EEG triggers sent on BioSemi parallel-port lines 1-4 (key values 2^n) and line 8 (MW probe = 128) via the legacy MATLAB digitalio API in run_mw_experiment6.m.
